responsibility: Implements SSA liveness analysis and the var_map partition infrastructure used by out-of-SSA and coalescing. It creates and maintains SSA-name partition maps for whole functions or loop regions, supports partition union/view compaction and base-index computation, computes live-variable data for partitions at block boundaries and statements, provides dumping and debugging of live sets and partition maps, and verifies that live-on-entry information is consistent with the current CFG and SSA definitions.
same_name_distinction: This source file implements the SSA liveness analysis and var_map/partition machinery, including partition creation and union, compaction/views, live-range computation, dumping, and verification. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-live.h, which defines the public data structures, inline accessors, and API declarations, this file performs the actual liveness and partition-management computations.
